title: ATM
keymap.start: ATM robbery: pry open or keep working
begin.unfit: You can't do that right now.
begin.spent: This machine has already been gutted.
begin.taken: Someone else is working this machine.
begin.cooldown: Lie low for another %d min before the next one.
begin.police: Too quiet out there. Needs %d officers on duty.
begin.assets: The machine parts didn't load. Try again in a moment.
pry.slip: The bar slipped off the seam.
pry.stuck: It's still holding. Give it a second.
screw.cam: The driver cammed out of the screw.
jumper.bolt: The solenoid kicks. The bolt is up.
jumper.alarm: Mains into the alarm loop. It's ringing.
jumper.dye: Mains into the tamper line. The dye pack fired.
jumper.short: Dead short. That one did nothing good.
jumper.settle: The coil hums but the bolt doesn't lift. Give the board a few seconds.
jumper.none_left: You're out of jumper leads. Unclip one first.
jumper.occupied: That terminal already has a clip on it.
cassette.locked: The cassette is still held by the bolt.
cassette.dye: A dye pack burst. The notes are stained.
cassette.alarm: The drawer broke the alarm loop.
end.dead: The machine locked itself down. Nothing more comes out of it.
hint.door: Set the bar in a seam and pull down. Hold it in the band until it gives.
hint.plate: Seat the driver on a screw and circle counter-clockwise. Too fast and it cams out.
hint.wires: Read the wires before you touch them. The legend is on the board.
hint.cassette: The bolt is up. Pull the cassette out by its handle.
settings.light_desc: Adds a soft, warm light just above your view in the close-up ATM camera, so the panel stays readable at night. Only you see it. Nothing changes if the server has turned the light off.
